Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 83. Category: form. Namekians.

Power-Up
Grow massive to overwhelm the enemy.:
At level 5 you may become a large category, this
increases to huge at level 10 and gargantuan at level
20.
Increase your Bulk and Power by 1 for each Size
Category you Grow.
Drains 2 stamina at the end of your turn per size
category raised.
